title: AuthorListWorkspacesResult
description:
`author.list_workspaces` result: every open authoring workspace and its
digest.

workspaces.description: The open workspaces, in id order.

WorkspaceDigest.description: One open workspace's digest line — enough for an agent to recover context.

base.description: The scope or fork name the staging is over.

branch.description: The branch this workspace targets, if any.

mode.description: The door the workspace was opened in.

WorkspaceMode.description:
The authoring door a workspace was opened in, on the wire. Mirrors the
internal `author::workspace::Mode` but is a wire-local type so the contract
layer stays independent of the workspace engine's internals.
